rules.title: Owner move-in eviction relocation assistance payment (2026 inflation-adjusted amounts)
rules.requirement: Owners who evict a tenant for owner move-in must pay relocation assistance. For 2026 the standard payment is $19,413, with an additional $6,471 for qualifying households, indexed annually to Bay Area CPI.
rules.key_value: $19,413 standard; additional $6,471 for qualifying households (effective 2026-01-01; 1.5% CPI adjustment)
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants in Berkeley rental units covered by the Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance who are evicted for owner move-in.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only when an owner move-in eviction occurs; additional payment depends on the household meeting qualifying criteria not stated in the document.

rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance (relocation assistance provisions)
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date and enacted date refer to the 2026 inflationary adjustment approved by the Rent Board on 2025-10-16, not the original ordinance enactment. Document does not give the municipal code section number or define qualifying households.

rules.title: Ellis Act withdrawal eviction relocation assistance payment (2026 inflation-adjusted amounts)
rules.requirement: Owners who evict tenants to remove a property from the rental market under the Ellis Act must pay the same relocation assistance as for owner move-in evictions. For 2026 this is $19,413 standard plus $6,471 for qualifying households.
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants in Berkeley evicted because the owner is withdrawing the property from the rental housing market (Ellis Act).

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only when an Ellis Act withdrawal eviction occurs; additional payment depends on the household meeting qualifying criteria not stated in the document.

rules.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
rules.conflict_note: Dates refer to the 2026 inflationary adjustment approved 2025-10-16, not the ordinance's original enactment. Document does not give the municipal code section number.
